title: Open stabilizers for geometric etale lifts
statement: Under the field hypotheses of the geometric point over Spec K, any monoid homomorphism to endomorphisms of the geometric etale fibre functor satisfying the extension precomposition formula has open stabilizers for each geometric lift.

proof.text: Factor x:Spec Omega -> X over Spec K through a lift l:Spec Ks -> X, using the proved source declaration Scheme.Hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleFiniteRefinement.GeometricLifts. Its hypotheses hold because Ks is separably closed and X -> Spec K is etale. Compatibility of the base maps is IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply. This is a direct specialization of a closed library theorem; no fibre-decomposition module is imported.

Construct H as the stabilizer of l under the concrete precomposition action on Ks-valued points. The continuity theorem [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous], together with Mathlib continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen for a discrete action, makes H open. The monoid homomorphism rho defines a MulAction on Omega-valued lifts, so the desired set is also a subgroup stabilizer.

For g in H, extend g to a K-automorphism tau of Omega. The private helper proves this directly from Mathlib: choose a transcendence basis v of Omega over Ks; identify A=Ks[v] with a multivariable polynomial algebra via AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquiv; apply g to coefficients with MvPolynomial.mapEquiv and transport to A. Omega is an algebraic closure of A by IsAlgClosed.isAlgClosure_of_transcendence_basis. IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv extends the coefficient automorphism to a ring automorphism of Omega, and equivOfEquiv_algebraMap gives its restriction to Ks. The tower identity and g.commutes show that it fixes K, so it is the required K-algebra automorphism. This helper is completely proved, using no postponed statements.

Apply the supplied formula hρ to tau. Substitute x=Spec(Ks -> Omega) followed by l. The extension equation and Spec.map_comp move Spec(tau) past Spec(Ks -> Omega); since g fixes l, the result is x. Equality of the underlying scheme maps gives equality of Over morphisms. Thus H is contained in the rho-stabilizer of x. Mathlib Subgroup.isOpen_mono proves the larger stabilizer open.

lean.statement:
theorem galoisPointAction_open_stabilizers
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ρ : Gal(Ks/K) →* End (pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber)
    (hρ : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (_ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X),
      ((ρ g).app X x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left) :
    ∀ (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X),
      IsOpen {g : Gal(Ks/K) | (ρ g).app X x = x}
